evidence.quote: Mandatory Payment within 15 Days of Work Completion.

passage_flags.claim: Trade between the two countries is an important part of the relationship as well.
passage_flags.problem: Not stated in the booklet. Page 9 only says bilateral trade is conducted under the ASEAN-India Trade in Goods Agreement (AITIGA); it does not say trade is important to the relationship.

passage_flags.claim: A manufacturer that receives lower prices for its output may reduce production, while a rise in the cost of materials or energy can squeeze profits and later feed into the prices of finished goods.
passage_flags.problem: The causal claim that lower output prices lead manufacturers to reduce production is not in the booklet (page 38-39 covers PPI definitions and the input/output cost measures only). The squeeze-and-pass-through point is general reasoning, not booklet text.

passage_flags.claim: Several initiatives are run by different bodies, so the same raw material can fall under more than one programme.
passage_flags.problem: Not stated in the booklet (pages 48-52). The booklet lists several biofuel schemes but never says one raw material can fall under more than one programme.
